scripts.install:all: bun install && cd server && bun install && cd ../client && bun install
scripts.dev: bunx concurrently -k "cd server && bun run dev" "cd client && bun run dev" "cd server && bun run worker:dev"
scripts.build: cd client && bun run build && cd ../server && bun run build
scripts.prod: bun run concurrently -k "cd server && bun run start:prod" "cd client && bun run prod"
scripts.local: bunx concurrently -k "cd server && bun run dev" "cd client && bun run dev"
